newsitem.title: UK: Chelsea to place one million new shares.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea to place one million new shares.

text.p: Chelsea Village Plc, the holding company that owns Chelsea football club, said on Monday that it has agreed to place just over one million new ordinary shares at 120p each.
It said in a statement that the shares will be issued shortly and that its brokers Ellis & Partners Ltd will receive 25,000 shares as their fee.
Chelsea also said it has agreed to issue 126,532 new ordinary shares at the mid-market price of 118.5p per share on January 24.
It said that a third of these will go Dennis Wise, the current captain of Chelsea football club.
Chelsea also agreed to issue up to 500,000 new ordinary shares at a price of 106.5p per share to Graham Bell, who has helped develop Chelsea's youth policy and team.
